messages:
elena: Hey team — quick heads up: we just published a community release: redwood-inference/quickstart-sdk v0.9.0.

elena: What's in it: smaller client binary, streaming improvements, and a new example for Dedicated + Private usage. Also updated the README with a migration guide for v0.8 -> v0.9. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart-sdk/releases/tag/v0.9.0 :tada:

elena: Important policy note: the repo license remains Apache-2.0, but we've added a short CONTRIBUTING.md that clarifies commit signing and CLA expectations for external maintainers. Please surface any legal concerns to @sam or @legal.

elena: Internal ask: if your team depends on the SDK, try a quick smoke test today. The release includes a small breaking change in the default retry backoff (now 300ms -> 200ms) that can affect throughput-sensitive code.

sam: Got it — thanks for the heads up. I'll draft an internal blurb for the Dedicated customers who pin v0.8.

sam: Also pinging @ben for any console/Console-docs updates we need to ship.

ben: I ran a couple local tests — looks good. We should add a note under Console > SDK Integrations that mentions the retry backoff change. I'll open a docs PR.

alex: Congrats! QuickQ: does this change affect the telemetry tags (we tag with sdk_version)?
alex: If yes we'll need to update our parsing and the optimize recommendations.

elena: @alex yes — sdk_version is bumped. We added an opt-in env var REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_BACKOFF=true to revert to old behavior for customers that need it.

release-bot: release published: redwood-inference/quickstart-sdk v0.9.0 by elena (sha: 4f2c9d). Artifacts: linux-amd64.tar.gz, mac-arm64.tar.gz, wheel. CI: green.

ci-bot: e2e smoke: passed on main with the default config (2024-04-24 16:12 UTC).

elena: Community ask: we'll be running a 2-hour office hours/hack session next Thursday 14:00-16:00 PT to help adopters migrate and to triage any issues. If you're able to volunteer as a maintainer or reviewer for incoming PRs, please drop into #eng-ml or add yourself to the TODO list in the release notes.

sam: I'll cover support triage during the session.

ben: I'll be on for the first hour to help with docs and sample updates.

alex: I'll take a look at telemetry changes and open any necessary migration PRs.

elena: Thanks all. If anyone sees community mentions or issues, please react with :eyes: and assign @elena or @sam. We'll track incoming items in the release board.

elena: Final note — this is the first community release where we asked for external maintainer nominations. We've had two orgs raise their hands; expect a follow-up with a short maintainer onboarding checklist next week.
